title: Axon Hub |  Auto Farm, Rebirth, Pets, Crystals
features:
One-Click Full Farm – Runs your main Muscle Legends training and rebirth progression from a single toggle.

Training Presets – Choose Punch Training, Weight Training, Best Machine, Balanced Training or manual control.

Auto Punch – Continuously trains Strength while following the game’s training timing.

Auto Training Tools – Automatically uses weights, situps, pushups or handstands.

Training Pace – Choose between normal game cooldowns, relaxed training or faster training.

Natural Training Timing – Slightly varies the delay between training actions.

Smart Machine Training – Finds and uses the best machine available for your current stats.

Machine Strategies – Select machines by best stat gain, highest usable tier, closest distance or random availability.

Automatic Weakest Stat – Detects whether Strength, Durability or Agility needs the most improvement.

Balanced Training – Rotates between machines to improve Strength, Durability and Agility.

Muscle King Machines – Optionally includes Muscle King equipment in automatic training routes.

Auto Treadmill – Finds and uses the best treadmill available for your current Agility.

Auto Rebirth – Rebirths automatically when your selected Strength requirement is reached.

Fast Rebirth – Uses available rep packs to reach the next rebirth faster.

Rebirth Timing – Rebirth immediately, save 25% extra Strength or wait for double Strength.

Rebirth Pet Loadouts – Equips rebirth bonus pets before rebirthing and restores Strength pets afterward.

Double Rebirth Pets – Waits for an available x2 Rebirth pet before completing the rebirth.

Auto Quests – Collects completed Muscle Legends quests automatically.

Auto Chests – Travels to and claims every chest currently ready.

Chest Routes – Claim all ready chests, the nearest ready chest or one selected chest.

Supported Chests – Includes Golden, Enchanted, Magma, Mythical, Legends, Jungle and Industrial chests.

Auto Group Reward – Claims the available Roblox group reward.

Auto Playtime Gifts – Collects free timed gifts as they become available.

Auto Fortune Wheel – Uses every available fortune wheel spin.

Auto Countdown Reward – Claims available update countdown rewards.

Auto Ultimate – Purchases your selected Ultimate upgrade when affordable.

Ultimate Upgrades – Supports Rep Speed, Pet Slots, Golden Rebirth, Jungle Speed, Chest Rewards and other available upgrades.

Auto Crystals – Opens crystals automatically at your selected interval.

Crystal Strategies – Open a selected crystal, the most expensive affordable crystal or the cheapest affordable crystal.

Bulk Crystal Opening – Choose how many crystals to open during each purchase.

Crystal Money Reserve – Keeps your selected amount of currency before purchasing crystals.

Inventory Protection – Stops opening crystals before your pet and power-up storage becomes full.

Best Pet Loadout – Keeps your strongest owned pets equipped automatically.

Pet Priorities – Select pets by total bonuses, Strength, Agility, Durability or rarity.

Strength Pet Loadout – Equips the best pets for maximum Strength gains.

Rebirth Pet Loadout – Equips pets with the strongest rebirth bonuses.

Auto Pet Shop – Purchases your selected pet without travelling to the shop.

Live Pet Prices – Displays the price, rarity and storage requirements for available pets.

Auto Evolve Pets – Combines ready five-copy pet sets automatically.

Duplicate Pet Scanner – Finds every pet type with enough copies to evolve.

Safe Pet Auto
